name: Fundrizer – Fundraising | Crowdfunding | Donation Plugin
author: LokusWP

sections.description:
Demo FSE | Demo Elementor

Fundrizer have mission to help people fundraising for their mission.

With Fundrizer, you can easily set up custom donation pages to accept contributions from supporters or manage multiple campaigns for your nonprofit organization — all with zero transaction fees.

Designed for the Block Editor, Fundrizer enables you to customize and visualize every block with ease. Create a donation website or fundraising platform that reflects your unique style and mission with no code, helping you inspire more supporters and achieve your goals.

Quick Links 🔗

  • Fundrizer
  • Docs
  • Learn More about Build Website WordPress FSE

Visual

  • Campaign List Page: Displays a list of active fundraising campaigns, providing clear visibility into diverse campaigns aligned with funders’ interests.
  • Campaign Single Page: Provides detailed information, including the campaign goal, progress, impact, and funding allocation. This approach engages funders deeply and inspires larger contributions through transparency and compelling storytelling.
  • Donor Form: Allows funders to quickly select predefined amounts, streamlining the funding process and potentially increasing conversion rates by reducing friction.
  • Donor Wall: Shows a list of donations received, including both pending and completed transactions.

Management

  • Campaigns: Manage Campaign and you can tags, and also create Campaign Update for your Campaign
  • Metrics: Setting metrics for campaigns helps define and measure success criteria, making campaign goals more realistic and achievable.
  • Analytics: Understanding audience behavior through data allows for informed decisions, leading to better outcomes.
  • Funders: Track how many funders you have and the total amount they are contributing.

Payment

  • WooCommerce Integration: The Fundrizer plugin seamlessly integrates with WooCommerce, offering a flexible and robust payment system. It supports multiple currencies and various payment methods to make receiving donations easier.
  • Supported Methods: Fundrizer leverages WooCommerce’s wide range of supported payment gateways, ensuring compatibility with popular methods like credit cards, PayPal, and more.
  • Add More Payment Methods: Enhance your donation platform by adding new payment methods using the Banking Blocks for WooCommerce plugin, ensuring donors have more options to contribute.

Notification

  • Email: Send notifications to funders about their contributions via email.
  • WhatsApp: Integrate with UnoWA to help you send notifications directly to funders via WhatsApp.

Do More Good with Our Starter Block Theme Fondasi
sections.faq:
Where can I get help if this plugin has issues?

For support with this plugin, please visit the Support Forums.

Privacy Policy

Fundrizer uses Appsero SDK to collect some telemetry data upon user’s confirmation. Integrating Appsero SDK DOES NOT IMMEDIATELY start gathering data, without confirmation from users in any case. Learn more about how Appsero collects and uses this data.
